hints.margin: The minimum margin is a warning threshold when setting a Pro plan's credits; it does not change what each use costs.
hints.free: Given once when a student first uses the app. A new value only applies to students who get it after saving; accounts switched from teacher get none.
hints.features: Credits per unit is what users are charged. Unit prices (VND per one million processing units) and the fixed cost are only used to compute the actual cost.
